title: 2020–2024 Model Y: Why That USB Port Only Charges
slides: Your Tesla Model Y USB port charges a phone, but will not read data? Check which port you are using before replacing the cable.
This tip covers the North America manual for twenty twenty through twenty twenty-four Model Y vehicles. Hardware can differ by build date.
Tesla says some vehicles built after roughly November first, twenty twenty-one, have center-console ports that only charge devices.
For those vehicles, the manual directs data functions to the glovebox USB port. The rear-console ports are charging-only.
Check the manual in your own car and inspect the installed ports while parked. A charging connection alone does not prove data support.

title: 2020–2024 Model Y: Clean the Screen Without Accidental Taps
slides: Cleaning a Tesla Model Y touchscreen while every wipe opens a menu? The manual describes a dedicated cleaning mode.
For the North America twenty twenty through twenty twenty-four Model Y manual, start while parked. Open Controls, then Display, then Screen Clean Mode.
The display goes dark so marks are easier to see, and wiping will not trigger the normal touchscreen controls.
Use a soft, lint-free cloth intended for displays. Tesla cautions against glass cleaner, hand-sanitizer gel, wet wipes, and statically charged cloths.
When finished, hold the on-screen exit control. Follow the manual for your installed software if the menus differ. The manufacturer source is linked below.

title: 2024 Ford F-150: Open Supported Windows With the Remote
slides: On a twenty twenty-four Ford F-one-fifty with Global Opening, the key remote can open supported windows with the ignition off.
First confirm your truck supports the feature and that it is enabled. Ford warns that online instructions can differ from the manual supplied with your vehicle.
With the truck parked and everyone clear of the windows, tap unlock once. Within one second, press and hold unlock again.
Let go when the windows begin opening. The manual says another press of lock or unlock stops Global Opening.
Watch the windows throughout. If your equipment or supplied manual differs, follow that manual. This is an independent explanation, not a feature fitted to every truck.
